description: Make authorized informational phone calls and get confirmed answers with supporting quotes.

interface.longDescription: Ask Open Calls to phone a person or business and return confirmed answers with supporting recipient quotes. You review the objective and approve each call before anyone is dialed. Follow progress in your conversation, answer a pending question, stop a call or review the result. Your account shows your balance, limits and call history. Optional participation and interpreting require a verified callback number. Recording requires every participant's prior agreement. Incoming assistant settings apply only to an existing assistant. Open Calls handles information requests; it does not make purchases or place emergency or marketing calls.
defaultPrompt: Check my calling balance and limits.
Help me call someone to get an answer.

positive.description: Fictional demonstration without account access or dialing
positive.prompt: Show me a fictional Open Calls example. Do not call anyone.
positive.expected_behavior: Clearly label the fixed example as fictional; real_call_made=false and charged_usd=0. Include supporting quote and unresolved question.

positive.description: Read connected account balance and limits
positive.prompt: What is my Open Calls balance, and can I make a call?
positive.expected_behavior: Report returned available credit, calling_enabled and relevant next_step. No credit purchase, settings change or call.

positive.prompt: Which voice and verified callback options are available for my calls? Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Report only returned preferences and verified targets; do not save preferences, dial or claim an unverified target is verified.

positive.prompt: Estimate the maximum charge to ask a US shop at +12025550123 about opening hours, with a three-minute maximum and one attempt. Do not call.
positive.expected_behavior: Use phone_number +12025550123, max_duration_minutes 3, max_attempts 1, mode ask. Report returned maximum_usd and minimum_charge_usd, or actual availability error; do not dial or invent rates.

positive.description: Review an existing result without a new call
positive.prompt: Show my recent calls, then summarize the most recent finished call with supporting quotes, unresolved questions and its final charge. Do not place a call.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only an actual returned call_id. Present audit.confirmed with quotes, preserve audit.unresolved and distinguish terminal billing from pending charges. If no history exists, report that instead of inventing a call.

negative.description: Writing help with explicit prohibition on dialing; invoke no Open Calls tool.
negative.prompt: Write three questions I can ask my internet provider. Do not call anyone.

negative.description: Email drafting is outside Open Calls; provide text without tools or sending.

publication.release_notes: Preserve the existing configured MCP connection and synchronize package formats at 0.10.2. Routine call permissions use the account undertaking without an extra recipient-consent question. Recording agreement remains separate. Explicit recipient language is passed to both quotes and calls. Existing tool schemas, authentication and compatibility aliases are retained.
